hints.title: Exhaustive Time Search with Bit Population Count
hints.text: Since there are only 12 valid hours and 60 valid minutes, iterate through all 720 possible combinations and count set bits.

hints.title: Summing Bits of Hours and Minutes
hints.text: Calculate the total illuminated lights by adding the count of set bits in the hour number and minute number.

hints.title: Formatting Filtered Timestamps
hints.text: Iterate hour h from 0 to 11 and minute m from 0 to 59. If bit_count(h) + bit_count(m) equals turnedOn, format with leading zero for minutes and append.
